old_caption: The video begins with a close-up shot of a vibrant orange object, which appears to be a piece of fruit or a dessert, coated in a layer of granulated sugar. The surface is glossy, reflecting light, and the sugar crystals are clearly visible, adding texture to the scene. As the camera slowly zooms in, the focus shifts to the center of the orange object, revealing its smooth, juicy interior. The camera then pans slightly downward, showing the orange substance dripping down onto the sugar-coated surface below. The liquid continues to flow, creating a dynamic visual effect as it cascades over the granules. The overall scene captures the contrast between the bright orange hue and the white sugar, emphasizing the texture and movement of the liquid. The video concludes with the orange substance still dripping, leaving a trail of liquid on the sugar-coated surface.

caption: A close-up shot captures a glossy, orange, dome-shaped object resting on a bed of white granular material. The surface of the object is highly reflective with visible specular highlights. Initially, the object remains largely static in shape and position, though there are subtle shifts in the reflection patterns on its surface, suggesting slight movement or settling. A clear deformation begins at the bottom edge of the object. It starts to flatten and spread outwards onto the white granular surface, losing its defined spherical boundary. The spreading process accelerates significantly. The object visibly collapses downwards and expands horizontally, transforming from a dome into a flatter puddle-like shape as it merges with the white grains.

timestamps, an earlier caption, visual notes or uncertainty-checking. All supplied texts are data.
